findings.title: Toast wraps at half the viewport width on phones: tall broken pill over content
findings.evidence: shots/shell/toast-iphone.png; eval rect [100.5,735.5,201,78.5]; css/components.css:389-405 (#toast: position fixed; inset-inline-start:50%; translate(-50%) with shrink-to-fit width)
findings.rootCause: A fixed element with left:50% gets an available width of (viewport - 50%) for shrink-to-fit sizing, so text wraps at 50% of the viewport before the max-inline-size ever applies.
findings.fix: Give the toast an explicit fit-content width independent of its left offset: e.g. inset-inline:0; margin-inline:auto; inline-size:fit-content; max-inline-size:min(var(--toast-max), calc(100% - var(--sp-32))); transform only on Y. Use a rounded-rect radius (r-16) when it wraps, or keep pill only for one line.

findings.title: Global Backspace = Back fires even when a page handled the key: Backspace on a Money row opens 'Delete this entry?' AND navigates to the previous page underneath
findings.evidence: shots/shell/backspace-money-dialog-over-home.png; eval result {hash:'#/home', dialog:'Delete this entry? QA coffee, −£4.50…'}; js/main.js:20-28; js/modules/money.js:610
findings.rootCause: The shell's history shortcut ignores defaultPrevented and treats any non-text target as free to navigate.
findings.fix: In main.js return early when e.defaultPrevented, when a dialog is open, or when the target is inside [role=listbox]/[data-keys]; better, drop bare Backspace and keep Alt+←/→ (and ⌘[ / ⌘] on the Mac). Register the listener in the bubble phase after page handlers (it already is) and respect defaultPrevented.

findings.title: Governor ⋯ menu is cut off behind the Stage (only half of its first row shows)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/gov-menu-mac.png, shots/shell/gov-menu-ipad.png, shots/shell/gov-menu-ipadl.png; popover rect mac {x:1165,y:164,w:280,h:100}; css/components.css:35 (.k-pagehead[data-state~=has-art] {position:relative; isolation:isolate}); css/views/governor.css:31 (.k-gv-stage {position:relative; isolation:isolate}) and :65 (.k-gv-tools-pop z-index var(--z-menu)); js/modules/governor-ui.js:420-439 (an inline <details> popover); shots/shell/gov-menu-mac-recheck2.png (re-check)
findings.rootCause: 34e made painted page headers an isolated stacking context; the z-index of the popover now only counts inside the header, and the Stage that follows (also isolated, later in DOM) paints over it. The Governor menu is a one-off <details> rather than the portalled KOS.ui.menu.
findings.fix: Use the shared KOS.ui.menu (it portals the panel to <body>, js/core/ui.js ~813) instead of a hand-made <details>; or give the painted page header z-index:var(--z-sticky) so its stacking context sits above the following content. Audit any other in-header inline popover after the 34e painted headers.

findings.title: iPhone bottom tab bar lost its labels: five bare kanji (灯 学 整 蒐 余) with no Home/Study/Productivity/Collection/More text
findings.evidence: shots/shell/seed-home-iphone.png, shots/shell/more-iphone.png (bar at y=818-874); eval: label rect {w:1,h:1}, clip rect(0px,0px,0px,0px), #cols has no data-rail and data-tree=none on a phone; css/layout.css:377 (inside @media max-width:1080px: #cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-label {position:absolute; clip:rect(0 0 0 0)} — specificity 1,2,0) beats css/layout.css:433 (.k-rail-label {position:static…} — 0,1,0) and :431 only covers data-rail=compact / tree open|closed
findings.rootCause: Regression from 4c29a2f (feat(ipad), 22 Oct): the iPad tier's ID-scoped label-hiding rule also matches at phone width and out-specifies the phone's class-level reset.
findings.fix: In the ≤700 block add the same reset for the 1080 tier's selector: '#cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-label, #cols:not([data-rail="full"]) .k-rail-count { position: static; inline-size:auto; block-size:auto; clip:auto; overflow:visible }' (or scope the 1080 rule with min-width:701px). Add a smoke/visual assertion that a phone tab label has width > 20px.

findings.title: Enter on a focused Cancel button CONFIRMS a non-danger confirm dialog (End session, Turn off notifications, Disconnect GitHub, Add a copy/Open existing...)
findings.evidence: eval: {enterOnCancel:'YES'}; js/core/ui.js:291-292 (function onKey(e){ if (e.key==='Enter' && !opts.danger) close(true); } on document); 51 ui.confirm call sites, the non-danger ones listed by grep in js/modules/focus.js, notifications.js, code.js, cardstats.js, governor-ui.js:450, jarun.js, medview.js, pwa.js:53
findings.rootCause: The affirmative Enter shortcut is bound at document level and ignores which control has focus.
findings.fix: Only treat Enter as yes when the target is not a button/link (e.g. if (e.key==='Enter' && !opts.danger && !(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('button,a,[role=button]'))) close(true)); or drop the document listener and rely on the focused confirm button's native Enter.

findings.title: 'Skip to content' navigates to Home instead of skipping: href='#main' is read by the hash router as an unknown route
findings.evidence: eval mac: {before:'#/calendar', after:'#/home', active:'main'}; index.html:61; js/core/router.js:302-306 (hashchange -> onPop -> parse fails -> home())
findings.rootCause: An in-page fragment link in an app that uses the fragment for routing.
findings.fix: Give the link a click handler that preventDefault()s and calls document.getElementById('main').focus({preventScroll:false}) (or make router.parse ignore hashes that do not start with '#/').

findings.title: On iPhone, Money's six views and Goals' This week/This month/All/Done tabs are unreachable: the phone hides the page tabs and its ▾ sheet lists the section's pages instead
findings.evidence: shots/shell/money-iphonesafari.png, shots/shell/money-sheet-iphonesafari.png, shots/shell/money-overview-iphone.png; eval: #/money tabs visible 0 of 6, subnavItems 6; #/goals visible 0 of 4; css/components.css:654 (#main[data-phone-title] [data-phone-tabs] {display:none}); js/modules/mobile-shell.js:457-468 (destinations: subnav first, page tabs only when no subnav); js/modules/money.js:128, js/modules/goals.js:303
findings.rootCause: The phone title bar treats 'section strip' and 'page tabs' as alternatives, but Money and Goals have both; the CSS hides the tabs unconditionally.
findings.fix: When the page carries [data-phone-tabs] and a subnav exists, show both in the sheet (section pages, then the page's own views under a sub-heading) or keep the page's tabs visible as a scroller under the title bar; add a smoke assertion that every [role=tab] in #main is visible or offered by the sheet at 402px.

findings.title: KOS.rerender() throws the page back to the top on every device: it saves/restores #main.scrollTop but #stage is the scroller
findings.evidence: eval: {'#/home': ['stage', 600, 0]}; eval reminders {b:[900,0], afterRerender:0, after Back: 0}; scroller probe: #stage overflow-y auto (scrollHeight 2152 / client 772), #main overflow visible; js/core/ui.js:353-356 (var top = main.scrollTop … main.scrollTop = top), js/core/ui.js:1521-1523 (main.innerHTML = ''; main.scrollTop = 0); iPhone eval ['stage',800,0]
findings.rootCause: The scroll container moved from #main to #stage (layout) but ui.js still saves/restores #main.scrollTop, which is always 0.
findings.fix: Introduce one KOS.ui.scrollRoot() (the #stage on wide layouts, document.scrollingElement on the phone) and use it in rerender (save before, restore after the view drew, and again on the next frame for async content) and in show() (reset to 0 on a real navigation; restore a remembered position per history index on Back/Forward, like the router already keeps args per index). Add a smoke test.

findings.title: Phone search chips file Goals under 'Collection' and Reports/Files under a fake 'Pages' section
findings.evidence: shots/shell/search-iphone-q.png; js/modules/hub.js:3592-3593 (SEARCH_SECTION: goals: "Collection"; reports/files absent → "Pages" at :3598)
findings.rootCause: Hard-coded section table not updated when Goals moved to Productivity and when Reports/Files search domains were added.
findings.fix: goals → Productivity, planner → Collection (Wishlist), reports → Home, files → Archive; derive the section from the same table the rail uses (KOS.sectionLanding / the rail's section ids) so a new domain cannot silently fall to 'Pages'.

findings.title: Global search cannot find app pages or features (typing 'money', 'goals', 'help', 'settings' finds no page)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/search-mac-money.png; shots/shell/search-iphone-q.png; js/core/search.js:291-307 (domain list), :194-199 (goal result opens 'goals', sub = g.status)
findings.rootCause: search.js only has record domains; the navigation map lives in the rail/mobile-shell and is not exposed to search.
findings.fix: Add a synchronous 'Pages' domain built from the rail/section tables (title + aliases like 'budget'→Money, 'badges'→Achievements, 'help'), ranked first on an exact page-name hit; add assessments and routines domains; open a goal at #/goals/<id> and print a human status.

findings.title: Phone '⋯ tools' and section-switch sheets stay open when the window grows past 700px, showing a phone sheet as a desktop modal
findings.evidence: shots/shell/phone-sheet-left-open-at-mac.png; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:584-589 (only activeMoreOverlay/activeSearchOverlay are closed), :516-539 (openTools moves the nodes out of the page)
findings.rootCause: The phone→wide cleanup list in syncShell was not extended when the tools and section sheets were added.
findings.fix: In syncShell when !phone.matches also close activeToolsOverlay and activeSectionOverlay (their onClose already puts the nodes back).

findings.title: Phone ⋯ tools sheet drops the group labels: Governor's sheet shows bare 'Live Full Off' and 'Mine Empty Sample' with no idea what they control
findings.evidence: shots/shell/gov-menu-iphone.png; js/modules/governor-ui.js:423-430 (labels are spans outside the data-phone-more nodes); js/modules/mobile-shell.js:516-520
findings.rootCause: openTools moves nodes individually and has no notion of a caption.
findings.fix: Mark the label+segment pair (a wrapper) as data-phone-more, or let openTools read each node's aria-label as a visible caption. Consider moving the test controls to Archive › developer settings or hiding them behind a setting.

findings.title: In-app Help & Guide is missing most features released since mid-October (Money, Goals, Reports, Exams hub, Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives, Achievements, Connections, the Assistant, the shop/Stage)
findings.expected: partly (W8 did only what paid off)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/help-mac.png, shots/shell/help-iphone.png; grep counts in js/modules/help.js: Money 0, Mind 0, Creatives 0, Achievement 0, Badge 0, Connections 0, Todoist 0, Japanese 0, Reports 0, Assistant 0; git log -1 js/modules/help.js = 26 Oct 2026
findings.rootCause: Help is a hand-kept array with no test tying it to the set of views, so each release added pages without entries.
findings.fix: Add sections: Money & Goals, Reports, Exams & Deadlines (replace 'Exams & Papers'), Study spaces (Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives), Achievements, The Governor's Seat & shop, Assistant, Connections, Notifications (move out of Collection), Writing by hand; give each a 'Open …' relation like the others. Add a smoke check that every rail destination / KOS.views id with a page header has at least one Help entry.

findings.title: Help & Guide entries that are now wrong
findings.expected: partly (W8 did only what paid off)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/help-mac.png ('·' before Data & housekeeping, 'Alt ← / →' shortcut only); js/modules/help.js lines 2-5, 40, 57, 62, 78-79 and the 'Autosave' entry; index.html (no nav-back, nav-fwd, save-dot); js/main.js:15-19; docs/GUIDE.md:158 and :418-431
findings.rootCause: Docs not updated with releases; no test.
findings.fix: Rewrite those entries against the current app; give 'Data & housekeeping' a glyph; add Backspace (or remove the shortcut, see the Backspace finding) to Useful shortcuts; refresh GUIDE.md §5 and the Money sentence.

findings.title: Review chip menu never names the review on iPhone ('Open · ready' / 'Skip review'), and Skip has no undo
findings.evidence: shots/shell/reviewchip-iphone.png, shots/shell/reviewchip-mac.png; js/modules/dayreview.js:705-709
findings.rootCause: Menu items assume the chip's text label is visible, which the phone header drops.
findings.fix: Give the menu a heading row ('Evening review · 3 steps') or make the first item 'Open the evening review'; make the hint describe the action; after Skip show a toast with Undo. Consider primary click = open, ▾ = Skip.

findings.title: Navigating to the page you are already on pushes a duplicate history entry, so Back appears to do nothing
findings.evidence: eval: {d0:2,d1:3,d2:5,h1:'#/calendar'} and {d0:7,d1:9,hash:'#/home'}; js/core/router.js:226-238 (pushEntry when !opts._nav, no route===lastRendered check)
findings.rootCause: The router wrapper treats every non-redraw show as a new navigation even when the route is unchanged.
findings.fix: In the KOS.show wrapper: if (!opts._nav && route === lastRendered) replaceEntry(route,arg) instead of pushEntry (still render, so a rail click on the current page refreshes/scrolls to top).

findings.title: The installed app has no Back control at all: the header's ‹ › were removed and iOS Home Screen apps have no browser Back
findings.evidence: shots/shell/standalone-goal-ipad.png (header: brand, search, clock, review chip, bell, avatar; no Back); eval: document.getElementById('nav-back') === null; git show 8fa52cb -- index.html; manifest.webmanifest display:standalone; js/main.js:16-19, js/core/router.js:211-216
findings.rootCause: The header arrows were removed for the browser case without a replacement for the standalone (installed) case.
findings.fix: Show a Back button in the header only when running standalone (matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') or navigator.standalone) or at phone width, enabled by KOS.canBack(); keep the browser's own Back elsewhere. Remove the dead lookups otherwise.

findings.title: A dialog survives navigation: Back (or a rail/route change) leaves the confirm open over the new page, still bound to the old page's record
findings.evidence: eval: {dialogStillOpenAfterBack:true, hash:'#/home'}; js/core/ui.js:1566-1571 (closeOpenMenu only); js/core/router.js:284-300 (onPop renders without consulting the dialog stack)
findings.rootCause: Dialogs are body-level overlays with no link to the route; navigation code only knows about menus.
findings.fix: In onPop: if KOS.ui.topDialog() exists, close the top dialog instead of navigating (push the entry back with history.go(1) or pushState) - the mobile pattern 'Back closes the sheet'; in KOS.show for non-_nav navigations close every dialog in dialogStack (calling each overlay.close so editors can ask about unsaved changes).

findings.title: Opening the bell puts focus on 'Mark all as read': one Enter/Space after opening clears every unread notice on every device, with no undo
findings.evidence: eval mac: bell focusOnOpen 'BUTTON:✓ Mark all as read'; js/modules/notifications.js:77-78 (markAllRead(); close()) and :140; KOS.notify.markAllRead has no undo path
findings.rootCause: Menu default focus = first focusable, and the bulk action is rendered first.
findings.fix: Focus the first notification row (or the panel heading) on open and put Mark all as read last; after marking, show a toast with Undo that restores the previous read map (the ids are known).

findings.title: First run writes four fake 'SAMPLE — … (edit me)' events into the real calendar; the mock exam becomes a real assessment that drives Home, alerts and the bell
findings.evidence: shots/shell/empty-first-iphone.png, shots/shell/empty-home-mac.png; eval on reset account: assess ['SAMPLE — Mock exam (edit me)'], notify ['Afternoon review','SAMPLE — Mock exam (edit me)','23 plan topics carried over into this week'], toast text; js/modules/calendar.js:698-712; js/main.js:102
findings.rootCause: A pre-hub demo seed still writes real records, and later domains (Exams migration, notifications, Google sync) treat them as the user's own.
findings.fix: Drop seedSamples (the Sample data mode covers demos) or mark seeded rows {sample:true} so the exam migration, alerts, notify, Home ladder and ext sync skip them, with one 'Remove the examples' action. Add a short first-run card on Home (connect cloud, pick subjects, import Collection) instead.

findings.title: Toast 'Undo' is unreachable without a pointer: the button is tabindex=-1 inside the aria-hidden #toast, and the spoken message never says Undo exists
findings.evidence: eval: {ariaHidden:'true', tabindex:'-1', hitIsBtn:true}; js/core/ui.js:73-87; 6 call sites with {label:'Undo'}
findings.rootCause: The toast was made aria-hidden for the live-region split (Phase F) before toasts gained actions.
findings.fix: Give action toasts their own non-hidden container (role=status) with a focusable button; announce 'msg. Undo available, press ⌘Z' and bind ⌘Z/Ctrl+Z (outside text fields) to the most recent toast action while it is shown; pause the timer while hovered/focused.

findings.title: Search ranks specification hits in syllabus order, not by relevance: 'binary' shows 'Fields, records and files' first and cuts 'Unsigned binary', 'Two's complement' and Code's 'Binary search trees' past the six shown
findings.evidence: eval: search('binary') title hits at indexes [1,3,4,7,8,12,14,15] of 30; listbox options for 'binary','integration','dijkstra' (printed); js/core/search.js:31 (PER_DOMAIN 6), :42-49 (rank), :60-73 (specDomain: res.slice(0, PER_DOMAIN), no rank); js/modules/hub.js searchSpec (returns specHits in index order)
findings.rootCause: Spec search is a filter, not a ranker, and the cross-domain layer truncates before ranking.
findings.fix: Score spec hits: exact title > title word-start > title contains > spec text > flashcard, then subject order; rank before slicing; add a final 'See all N results' option that opens a results page (or expands the domain).

findings.title: Tapping a notification often lands on a generic page: Daily Review notices open Routines (not the review), routine-window notices ignore the routine, goal notices open the Goals list, and cold-start pushes drop object args
findings.evidence: shots/shell/notify-review-open.png; eval: notify kinds review:routines:object, goal:goals:null; goal open -> '#/goals'; js/core/notify.js:196-199; js/core/dayreview.js:713; js/core/routines.js:560; js/modules/routines.js:469-473; js/core/goals.js:807; sw.js:147,154
findings.rootCause: Producers set view/arg shapes the target views never learned to read, and the SW re-implements routing.
findings.fix: Routines view: if arg.review open KOS.reviewSheet for that slot; if arg.routine open the player/editor. Goals notices: link {view:'goals', arg:{id}}. In the push payload send the router hash (KOS.router.routeFor) and let sw.js open it verbatim; for in-app kos-open keep view+arg.

findings.title: Kurenai cannot open 13 current pages: app_navigate's view list stops before Money, Reports, Routines, Files, Achievements, Connections, Storage, Pen and ink, the Assistant and the four study spaces (Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives)
findings.evidence: eval: Object.keys(KOS.views) minus NAV_VIEWS = [pen, code, japanese, creatives, mind, routines, files, storage, connections, assistant, money, reports, achievements]; js/core/aitools.js:2735-2740 (NAV_VIEWS), :30 (SUBJECTS), :2741-2766 (app_navigate)
findings.rootCause: Hand-maintained enum duplicated from the route table; nothing fails when a view is added.
findings.fix: Derive NAV_VIEWS from KOS.views (minus internal ones) or from the router's route table, take subject from KOS.subjects.ids(), and accept the arg shapes the router accepts (e.g. money page, reports week). Add a smoke check that every registered view is navigable.

findings.title: No first run: a new device opens straight onto a busy Home that is already "23 behind" with 3 unread notices, and nothing offers to sign in and bring the account's data over
findings.evidence: shots/shell/empty-home-mac.png, shots/shell/empty-first-iphone.png, shots/shell/empty-home-ipad.png; eval after reset: notify items [cal:1:2026-11-10:10080 SAMPLE — Mock exam, pace:carry:2026-11-02 23 plan topics carried over, review:evening:2026-11-05], #sync-status hidden; grep: no onboarding/firstRun code in js/; js/modules/calendar.js:704-708 (sample events); js/main.js:106 (KOS.pacing.ensureSeeded seeds the whole plan, past weeks included)
findings.rootCause: Boot seeds sample events and the full plan unconditionally and has no pristine-state branch.
findings.fix: Add a one-screen first run (shown while the state is pristine and signed out): "Sign in to bring your data" (cloud), "Start fresh", and the theme choice; suppress the sample calendar events and the pacing carry-over notice until the user chooses; show a quiet "Not synced — sign in" header chip while signed out on a device that has never synced.

findings.title: One toast slot: each new toast replaces the last, so in the Daily Review (or Home's Today ticks) only the most recent triage can be undone; toasts also vanish after a fixed 2.6 s whatever their length
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:71-87 (single node, textContent replace, fixed 2600/8000 ms); Undo toasts at js/modules/dayreview.js:534, :615, :621, :622; js/modules/hub.js:964; js/modules/reminders.js:344
findings.rootCause: The toast is a single-slot primitive and Undo was layered on it without a queue.
findings.fix: Queue or stack toasts (at most 3, newest on top) and never drop one that carries an action until its time ends; scale duration to text length (e.g. 2.6 s + 60 ms/char, max 10 s) and pause on hover/focus; in the Daily Review keep an inline "Undo" on each triaged row instead of relying on the toast.

findings.title: The URL does not record many pages: the Wall's tabs and set pages, an opened assignment or reminder, a review run all collapse to the bare route, so a reload, a bookmark or the Home Screen app relaunch lands on the wrong page
findings.evidence: eval: #/achievements/recent and #/achievements/titles render with the Sets tab selected; cold load of #/achievements/sets -> hash #/achievements; shots/shell/ach-titles-deeplink-mac.png (hash #/achievements/titles, Sets selected); js/core/router.js:30-148 (ENCODE/DECODE lack achievements, assignments, reminders, review, cardstats), :150-154 routeFor; js/modules/achievements.js:110-115 (reads arg as "tab/id"); js/core/files.js:146; js/core/search.js:115; js/modules/due.js:103-173
findings.rootCause: Route codecs live in a central table in router.js that new views/args were not added to; routeFor silently drops unknown args.
findings.fix: Add codecs for achievements (tab, set/<id>), assignments (id), reminders (id/section), review (tab, run) and cardstats; better, make each view declare its own route codec next to its KOS.views registration and have a smoke test round-trip every KOS.show call site through routeFor/parse.

findings.title: Nothing redraws the open page when the day changes: header clock says Mon 2 Nov, Home still says Sunday 1 November / Good evening
findings.evidence: shots/shell/bell-mac.png (clock 00:00 Mon 2 Nov vs hero Sunday 1 November); js/main.js:86-97 (only the clock ticks every 20 s); js/main.js:199-204 (30-min interval refreshes HUD and rail counters but never the view); hub.js:623 reads new Date() only when drawn
findings.rootCause: Day-dependent views read new Date() only at draw time and the shell has no day-rollover redraw.
findings.fix: In tickClock, remember the date string; when it changes (and on visibilitychange after a day boundary) call KOS.rerender() if no dialog/ink/Focus is busy (the rerender already waits on KOS.inkUI.busy).

findings.title: Help on iPhone: section chips wrap into a ragged left-aligned cloud
findings.evidence: shots/shell/help-iphone.png
findings.rootCause: help.css nav reflows as flex-wrap at phone width.
findings.fix: Use the shared scroller (one line, horizontally scrollable, declared overflow) or the phone title bar's section switch for the eight sections.

findings.title: document.title never changes: every page, history entry and app-switcher card reads "Kurenai OS — Study Atelier"
findings.evidence: eval after navigating to #/calendar: title "Kurenai OS — Study Atelier"; grep document.title → only js/modules/focus.js:1072,1494
findings.rootCause: The router owns the URL but not the title.
findings.fix: In router.js after a successful show, set document.title = "<page h1 or section label> · Kurenai" (Focus keeps prefixing its countdown).

findings.title: Unknown or stale deep links fall back silently (to Home, or to a list) with no message
findings.evidence: eval: invalid → #/home, badTopic → #/home, badGoal → stays #/goals/doesnotexist showing the list
findings.rootCause: invariant 65 replaces invalid routes with Home but nothing tells the user.
findings.fix: When the router replaces an invalid route, toast "That page is no longer here" (and for a missing record, "That goal was deleted") and normalise the URL.

findings.title: Collapsed rail (Mac, iPad portrait) is kanji-only with no tooltip and drops the due-count badge
findings.evidence: shots/shell/rail-collapsed-mac.png; shots/shell/empty-home-ipad.png; eval: rail items have no title attribute; toggle rect 24x24 at (59,76); css/layout.css:213-235, :377
findings.rootCause: The compact rail hides label and count together via the same sr-only clip.
findings.fix: Give each rail item title=<label> (or a CSS tooltip on :hover/:focus-visible when compact); show the count as a small dot/number on the tile when compact; give the toggle a 44px invisible hit area on coarse pointers (padding + negative margin) while drawing the 24px circle.

findings.title: Search result sub-lines print raw data: 'Due 2026-10-28', goal status 'completed'/'active'
findings.evidence: eval of the search listbox for 'reminder 2' → 'Reminder 2Due 2026-10-28'; shots/shell/search-iphone-q.png (Goal 2 · completed); js/core/search.js:113 ("Due " + r.due), :196 (sub: g.status)
findings.rootCause: search.js builds its own sub-lines instead of the owners' formatters.
findings.fix: Format with the shared date helper used by Reminders ('Wed 28 Oct', 'Overdue · 28 Oct'), and map goal status to 'Reached'/'In progress'/'Missed'.

findings.title: Header controls on Graphite: the Assistant emblem is near-invisible and the four header controls are four different heights
findings.evidence: shots/shell/hdr-mac-right-crop.png (dark), shots/shell/dawn-bell-mac.png (Dawn); eval: chip 203x40, bell 38x38, assistant 38x38, syncdot 32x32 (mac); phone chip 44x40; index.html assistant-trigger img
findings.rootCause: Raster emblem has no dark-theme variant; header controls size themselves from different tokens.
findings.fix: Use a light/outlined variant of the emblem (or the bloom brand mark) on dark themes, or tint via a mask with --text; size every header control from one token (--icon-btn, 44 on coarse) and give the chip min-block-size var(--hit-coarse) on touch.

findings.title: ui.js still keeps a second, dead navigation stack (navHist/navFwd, KOS.back/forward/canBack) that the router overwrites
findings.expected: partly (W8 did only what paid off)
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:325-336, :409-420, :1556-1562; js/core/router.js:248-251; document.getElementById('nav-back') === null
findings.rootCause: The router was layered over ui.js's original stack without removing it.
findings.fix: Delete navHist/navFwd and the ui.js back/forward functions; keep navCur only for the redraw key.

findings.title: docs/GUIDE.md (the plain-words guide) stops at 26 Oct: Creatives and Mind are listed as 'still on the way', and Achievements, Connections, the art/shop release and the Stage are absent
findings.expected: partly (W8 did only what paid off)
findings.evidence: docs/GUIDE.md headings (lines 45-418), :418-430; git log -1 docs/GUIDE.md = 26 Oct 2026; grep -ci counts
findings.rootCause: Two hand-kept guides with no release checklist item or test.
findings.fix: Add tour sections for Mind, Creatives, the Exams hub, Routines and the Daily Review, Achievements, the Stage and shop, Connections; move shipped items out of §5. Generate Help's sections and GUIDE.md from one source (or have a smoke test that every rail destination is named in both).

findings.title: iPad-portrait overlay rail: Escape does not close it, a tap on the page both closes it and activates what was under the finger, and its open state is persisted
findings.evidence: eval at 820x1180: {s1:'full', focusIn:false, afterEsc:'full'}; js/main.js:71-81 (no Escape handler; stage pointerdown closes without preventing the click); :63-69 (setRail persists railOpenNarrow)
findings.rootCause: The narrow rail reuses the persistent open/closed preference of the docked rail instead of being a transient drawer.
findings.fix: Treat the narrow overlay like the spine drawer: add a scrim (or capture the first pointerdown and preventDefault/stopPropagation the following click), close on Escape (unless a dialog is open) and return focus to the toggle; don't persist the narrow overlay state (start closed).

findings.title: iPad touch targets in the shell: the rail toggle is 24x24 and the collapsed rail buttons are 30px wide (narrower than their own 32px tile)
findings.evidence: eval --size ipad: rail-toggle rect {x:59,y:76,w:24,h:24}; rail items [BUTTON,x21,w30,h44,padding 4px 0]; review chip 203x40; shots/shell/rail-tiles-ipad-crop.png; css/layout.css:213-235 (.k-rail-toggle 24px, coarse override to --hit-dense), :297-309 and :375 (tile 32px, item padding 4px 0)
findings.rootCause: The dense-size exception was applied to the rail toggle to avoid an oval; the compact rail item has no minimum width.
findings.fix: On coarse pointers give the rail toggle a 44px invisible hit area (a ::after inset that does not overlap the spine) or make it a 44px circle; give collapsed .k-rail-item min-inline-size: 44px (the rail is 71px wide); raise the header chip to the 44px touch height used by the other header controls.

findings.title: A hidden live region announces a bare number ("545") at boot: #node-count is aria-live but only holds the total leaf count
findings.evidence: eval mac: live regions [search-count:"", node-count:"545", kos-live-polite:"Routines", kos-live-assertive:""]; index.html:119; js/modules/hub.js:319-321
findings.rootCause: Leftover live region from the pre-Graphite rail that showed a node count; violates invariant 66 (announce is the sole live-region route).
findings.fix: Drop aria-live from #node-count (or delete the element: no reader uses it); invariant 66 already makes KOS.a11y.announce the sole live-region route.

findings.title: Hold-⌘ shortcut sheet is a fixed list: it shows Ink/PDF/Flashcard keys on every page and omits the shortcuts that exist (Backspace back, Esc, Money row keys, the Daily Review and routine player arrows and S, the story keys, the quiz arrow)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/cmd-hold-mac.png; sheet rect {x:275,y:112,w:920,h:237}; js/core/desk.js:39-44 (static SHORTCUTS array)
findings.rootCause: SHORTCUTS is a hard-coded array in desk.js written for the iPad ink release; later features added keys without a place to declare them.
findings.fix: Build the sheet from a registry: global keys plus a group contributed by the current view (KOS.desk.register(viewId, rows)); show only groups relevant to the page; align keys in a fixed-width column (grid) and use the 12-13px kbd token.

findings.title: KOS.show with an unknown view id draws a blank page and pushes it into history (#/archive, #/nonsense) instead of falling back like a typed URL does
findings.evidence: shots/shell/archive-empty-mac.png (blank main at #/archive); eval {has:false, h3:"#/nonsense", mainLen:0}; js/core/ui.js:1592; js/core/router.js:226-238
findings.rootCause: Unknown-route handling exists only in the hashchange/popstate path, not in KOS.show.
findings.fix: In KOS.show, if !KOS.views[viewId] log a console.warn and redirect to home with replace (same rule as router invalid routes) before pushing any entry.

findings.title: <body> also carries data-theme ("legacy hook, harmless"), so every derived token is re-derived on body: anything that sets the theme on <html> alone renders Graphite's derivations under Dawn's roles
findings.expected: partly (W8 did only what paid off)
findings.evidence: shots/shell/empty-home-iphonesafari.png (harness --theme: faint date and Daily goal kickers); eval html vs body token comparison all false; eval after KOS.governor.setTheme(atelier-dawn): kickers oklch(0.42 0.08 235)/oklch(0.42 0.06 200); js/core/governor.js:777-778; css/tokens.css:1262 (:root, [data-theme]); css/themes.css:62; audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/kos.mjs:107-108
findings.rootCause: Duplicate theme attribute on body combined with a derived-token block that matches any [data-theme] element.
findings.fix: Remove document.body.dataset.theme (nothing reads it as a hook; check with grep), or narrow tokens.css to ":root, [data-theme]:not(body)". Fix the harness to call KOS.governor.setTheme instead of setting the attribute.

findings.title: Reports has no rail item marked: on #/reports and every report page no destination is current (Reports lives under Home)
findings.evidence: eval: {#/reports: cur:""}, {#/reports/week/2026-10-26: cur:""}; compare #/achievements cur "守Governor", #/connections cur "蔵Archive"; js/core/ui.js:426-439 (SECTION_OF has no reports entry)

findings.fix: Map the reports view to the Home rail item in the rail/tab-bar section table (wherever achievements->governor is mapped).

findings.title: iPhone in landscape gets the iPad shell with nothing for its height or the Dynamic Island: the rail's profile chip is cut off below the screen and no left/right safe-area insets exist anywhere
findings.evidence: shots/shell/iphone-landscape-home.png (874x402); eval {rail:[342,364,"visible"], profile:[382,420], vh:402}; grep env(safe-area-inset-left|right) in css/ = 0; index.html:5 viewport-fit=cover; css/layout.css:437-440 (only top/bottom insets, phone tier only)
findings.rootCause: Composition is chosen by width only; safe-area handling written for portrait phones.
findings.fix: Pad #topbar and #cols with env(safe-area-inset-left/right); let #rail scroll (overflow-y:auto) or hide the profile chip when the rail is shorter than its content; consider treating a short landscape viewport (max-height ~500px) with the phone composition via a feature query on height rather than a new width breakpoint.

findings.title: Header sync status is an unlabelled 8px grey dot: signed out, offline and idle look identical, and on iPad/iPhone (no hover) nothing says what it is; the search box also shows a "/" key hint on touch devices
findings.evidence: shots/shell/hdr-ipad-crop.png (grey dot at far right, "/" badge in the search box); shots/shell/hdr-right-mac-crop2.png; eval: sync-status outerHTML text "Signed out", data-sync=idle, title "Cloud sync — Signed out (click for details)"; js/modules/cloudui.js:68-85 (state map: anything but synced/syncing/pending/error -> idle); css/layout.css:148-153
findings.rootCause: Status chip reduced to a dot in the Graphite redesign with the label moved into title only.
findings.fix: Give signed-out and offline their own look (a struck or hollow dot, or a short text chip "Not synced"/"Offline" at widths that allow it); show the state in words in the phone More sheet; hide the "/" badge under (hover: none).
